trello.name: Queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Kofi to add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet, not just payment workers, with the same thresholds everywhere: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. To be done in one pass.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic
trello.desc: Marta to fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Also add tests that simulate processor 503s to cover the scenario.

trello.name: Increase and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi to bump the DB connection pool from the default of 20 to 100 connections and split the worker and API pools so they no longer share a single pool. Both changes in the same config file as one change.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya to update the payment incident runbook (Kofi to confirm assignment with her after the meeting). Update logging links to replace old Kibana references turned off in March, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify that escalation phone numbers are current since one still routes to someone who left last year.

trello.name: Automate status page updates
trello.desc: Marta to automate status page updates using the status provider's API. Wire it to the checkout error rate alert so that when the alert fires, the status page automatically flips to investigating with a template message. Start with checkout alert; can extend to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Kofi to draft a plan for a controlled chaos test (game day) of the payment processor failover, starting in staging then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The plan will be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the plan is reviewed. Kofi leads and writes the draft.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi to upgrade Redis from version 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. The migration involves a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it requires a proper change window scheduled with the infra calendar, not a casual Friday deploy.

trello.name: Write incident timeline document
trello.desc: Ines to write up the incident timeline document tonight, to be sent out tomorrow.

trello.name: Post team lunch headcount to channel
trello.desc: Marta to post the headcount for the Thursday team lunch at the Thai place to the team channel, as the restaurant needs a headcount.
